caption:
A research team analyzed 159,041 Lovable projects and found sensitive data readable without a login. Examples: a forum exposing 80,000+ profiles and 200,000+ chat messages, and a service provider exposing 1,000+ records with passport details. The researchers could not establish whether any of it was misused, and they say the 30% figure is not a confirmed leak rate.

My reading: vibe coding gets you to a demo in a day. Production needs access rules, security review and measurement. Without them, speed turns into a data breach.

This is a problem I had to solve. The AskMoses.AI development team is 100% agentic. Every dev works with Claude Code on the project. Another Claude reviews the pull request. The human decides on business grounds, not technical ones. Deploys run on Vercel with 1-click rollback and daily backups.

The question is not whether AI writes your code. It is who checks it before customers rely on it.

Comment CLAUDE and I'll DM you how I did it.

Sources: crissyfield.de
